name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free desktop app that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narration or audiobooks — all running on your own computer, no subscription to a cloud voice service needed.
buyer: An indie content creator, e-learning studio, or small publisher who currently pays monthly for ElevenLabs or a dubbing service and wants to cut that cost to zero for high-volume work.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber dubs their tutorial channel into Spanish, Hindi, and Portuguese overnight without paying per-minute dubbing fees.
A small publisher turns its backlist of ebooks into audiobooks in-house instead of paying a narration studio per title.
A corporate training team clones a single presenter's voice once and generates dozens of localized course narrations from updated scripts.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you dubbing/audiobook service built on top of VoiceStudio, charging per finished minute of audio.
Sell a hosted, easier-to-use wrapper with managed voice libraries for creators who don't want to self-host.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple web front-end around VoiceStudio that takes a YouTube link and target language and spits out a dubbed video, then sell it as a $20-per-video service to small creators.
